emergence.summary: The commonest skeletal dysplasia: a recurrent FGFR3 gain-of-function (G380R) constitutively activates the growth-plate brake, so endochondral elongation is suppressed -> disproportionate short stature.

grades.perturbation_direction: [F] forced by (role x mechanism); cited biology
grades.perturbation_magnitude: [O] OPEN -- how far the switch moves is runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable

per_gene.note: G380R transmembrane substitution -> ligand-independent constitutive kinase

emergence.firewall: gamma reads promoter switch-threshold STRUCTURE only; perturbation DIRECTION is forced+cited; MAGNITUDE is [O] (runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable).

levers.push_direction: boost CNP->NPR2->cGMP, which OPPOSES the over-active FGFR3/MAPK brake
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] the downstream brake-suppression magnitude is not derived from sequence

levers.agent_class: FGFR3-TKI / soluble FGFR3 decoy (infigratinib, recifercept; investigational)

lead_corrective_lever.push_direction: boost CNP->NPR2->cGMP, which OPPOSES the over-active FGFR3/MAPK brake
lead_corrective_lever.mechanism_grade: [O] the downstream brake-suppression magnitude is not derived from sequence

modelling.grade: [F] ordering forced ; delta/treat_frac documented choices ; realised magnitude [O]

treatment_A_switch.firewall: levers are DIRECTION + cited agent CLASS; not dose/potency/efficacy/safety, not a recommendation to treat any individual.

falsifiers.claim: FGFR3 GOF moves the growth-plate emergent axis DOWN (brake over-active)
falsifiers.falsifier: an FGFR3 GOF allele that INCREASES limb length, or a growth-plate in which constitutive FGFR3 signalling raises chondrocyte proliferation, refutes the brake direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: growth-plate chondrocyte proliferation index in an Fgfr3-G380R model; limb-length cohort by genotype

falsifiers.claim: boosting NPR2/CNP (vosoritide axis) is the CORRECTIVE direction (opposes the brake)
falsifiers.falsifier: if CNP/NPR2 activation reduced rather than restored endochondral growth, the 'oppose the brake' lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: endochondral growth response to a CNP analogue in an Fgfr3-GOF growth-plate

gate_falsifiers.gate: falsifier register (>=1 measurable falsifier per disease)
